titolo: Utah’s Redtail AI supercomputer expands access while keeping university sovereignty
descr: The Redtail AI Factory, funded with $50 million, ranks 159 on TOP500, offers statewide AI resources and lets the University of Utah retain operational control.
paragrafi: The University of Utah launched Redtail, an AI Factory supercomputer that serves the state’s higher‑education, government and commercial sectors.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise designed and deployed Redtail as a turnkey system, and the Center for High Performance Computing operates it.
The platform reflects a $50 million investment from public and private partners over five years.
Redtail placed 159 on the June 2026 TOP500 list and 76 on the Green500 list, showing strong performance and efficiency.
Operational sovereignty lets the university control allocations, security and hybrid on‑prem and cloud usage, supporting both open and regulated research.
perche: Researchers across Utah gain high‑end GPU capacity without sacrificing data control, accelerating AI projects and workforce training. Free‑model users benefit from a more open research environment that can free up resources for regulated workloads, while local institutions see a template for balancing access with sovereignty.
